title: TeraWulf eyes $3.5B debt raise for Anthropic-linked data center: Report
summary: Bitcoin miner TeraWulf is reportedly seeking $3.5 billion in debt financing led by Morgan Stanley for its Kentucky data center campus leased by AI company Anthropic.

title: Metaplanet explores Bitcoin-backed digital credit with JPYC in Japan
summary: Metaplanet said it is studying Bitcoin-backed digital credit products in Japan with JPYC and Progmat, but no product has been launched.

title: Bitcoin returns to $64.3K with new three-week BTC price highs imminent
summary: Bitcoin bulls faced "crucial resistance" at $65,000 next as BTC price action diverged from oil and US dollar strength.

title: EU parliament passes ‘chat control,’ allowing private chat scans until 2028
summary: EU lawmakers have again allowed tech firms to scan chats for abuse material, but exempted end-to-end encrypted messages.

title: Robinhood Chain sees over $70M in ETH bridged during first week
summary: Robinhood’s choice to use Ethereum further solidifies its position as the “ultimate settlement layer and liquidity foundation for tokenized assets,” said HashKey Group’s Tim Sun.

title: Zcash targets July 28 launch for Ironwood network upgrade
summary: Zcash’s next upgrade will replace the once-compromised Orchard pool and may offer clues about whether counterfeit tokens were created via a recent bug.

title: Hackers tried to backdoor Injective npm package to steal wallet keys
summary: The incident is significant for developers and applications that handle Injective wallet workflows, Socket researchers said.

title: DeFi may be ‘quietly re-rating’ given outperformance against Bitcoin: Bitwise
summary: “DeFi usually swings much harder than Bitcoin, so holding up this well is unusual,” says Bitwise, as DeFi tokens have outperformed Bitcoin.

title: Coinbase chief legal officer to transition to advisory role on July 31
summary: The soon-to-be former chief legal officer did not announce the details of his next move but said that he would continue working with the Board of Coinbase National Trust Company.

title: Bitdeer stock jumps 14% as company expands US mining hardware production
summary: Bitdeer shares rallied after the company announced a $36 million Nevada manufacturing facility that will produce its SEALMINER Bitcoin mining machines and expand its hardware business.
